##### Project general facts

Marlin Icon by Cosmo Developments presents a curated collection of two‑to‑four bedroom apartments together with distinctive duplexes, totaling one hundred and forty thoughtfully arranged homes for modern families. The design embraces soft‑edged architecture and generous spatial proportions, delivering a sense of poise and motion that defines the tower’s silhouette. Refined contemporary interiors imbue each residence with a calm elegance that feels both inviting and timeless.  

A striking pool overlooks the water, complemented by a dedicated pool for younger guests, while a fully equipped gymnasium incorporates a specialised yoga and stretch zone for holistic wellbeing. A vibrant children’s play area offers a dedicated realm for exploration, and retail outlets on the ground and lower levels provide everyday convenience within the community. These amenities combine to craft a self‑contained environment where leisure and practicality coexist seamlessly.  

The interiors celebrate elegant contemporary design, where abundant natural light, warm tones and the finest materials converge to create sophisticated living spaces. Family‑scale living areas feature expansive glazing that frames panoramic canal and skyline vistas, while kitchens are equipped with premium fittings and bathrooms showcase meticulous detailing. Every element has been considered to deliver everyday luxury and lasting comfort.  

##### Location description and benefits

Al Reem Island stands as one of the capital’s most sought‑after districts, where the pulse of Abu Dhabi intertwines with the calm of waterfront living. Bridges link the island directly to Downtown Abu Dhabi, and short distances to Al Maryah and Saadiyat open a spectrum of cultural, retail and leisure experiences. The setting effortlessly shifts between daily rhythm and exceptional tranquility.  

The neighbourhood enjoys superb connectivity, with Al Reem Central Park a brief stroll away and Reem Mall within convenient reach, while landmark institutions such as Louvre Abu Dhabi, Saadiyat Island and Cleveland Clinic Abu Dhabi sit only a short journey from the island. Downtown Abu Dhabi and Yas Mall lie nearby, and Zayed International Airport provides swift access for both business and leisure travel. The waterfront ambience, coupled with a rising reputation, positions the island as a premier address in the emirate.  

Surrounding the island are serene canal views, verdant mangrove ecosystems and a host of cultural and commercial hotspots that capture Abu Dhabi’s distinctive character. Continued development and a strategic central location forecast a vibrant future and enduring value for inhabitants and investors. This environment blends peaceful waterfront living with the dynamic allure of a forward‑thinking metropolis.
